onboarding.privacyDescription: File contents are stored encrypted. Access records and some metadata are visible to the service. Secure Drop key recovery and custodian account recovery also involve server-managed key material.
onboarding.whatStaysPrivateDesc: Stored file contents need their decryption keys. Different delivery and recovery paths manage those keys differently; account recovery does not replace every original file PIN or password.
onboarding.whatYouControlDesc: Review each direct, group, folder or public-link permission and close the relevant route. Revocation cannot recall downloaded copies or stop a transfer already in progress.
onboarding.agentsBoundedDesc: Automation uses scoped credentials. Grant only the access it needs and review its recorded actions.
onboarding.pinDescription: A 4-digit PIN secures your vault, future shares, Secure Drop, and quick login.
onboarding.afterStep1: Unlock the vault without extra friction
onboarding.afterStep2: Create secure links with the same trusted session
onboarding.afterStep3: Keep control visible across every share and sender route
onboarding.accountPasswordHelp: We use this once to re-wrap your private key so your one PIN works everywhere in {{productName}}.
onboarding.previousPasswordHelp: Your administrator may have reset your password. Enter your previous password to recover your encryption key.
onboarding.enterPasswordForPin: Enter your account password to finish PIN setup.
onboarding.folderDescription: Organize incoming files from clients with a dedicated folder.
onboarding.readyDescription: Your PIN is set, your encryption key is protected, and the app can now work with you instead of interrupting you.
onboarding.readyCheck1: Your one PIN now protects the vault and every owner-controlled secure route
onboarding.readyCheck2: Secure Drop and shared-download recovery can reuse the same trusted session
onboarding.readyCheck3: You can see, review, and revoke outside access without losing your calm overview
onboarding.readyCheck4: You only set this once. {{productName}} now carries that trust through normal owner flows.

receiptDrawer.title: Security Receipt
receiptDrawer.subtitle: Cryptographic audit trail
receiptDrawer.zkExplanation: File contents are stored encrypted and decrypted in the browser for preview or download. Secure Drop can recover delivery keys on the server, and custodian recovery temporarily handles approved key parts there. Access records and some metadata are also visible to the service. A receipt records server activity, not proof that a recipient saved or read a file.
receiptDrawer.noActivity: No audit entries recorded yet for this file.

recovery.resetSuccess: Password reset successfully. You can now log in.
recovery.originalFileCredential: Recovery restores eligible account key material. Files encrypted with an earlier PIN or file password still need that original credential. A new PIN does not re-encrypt existing files. Support cannot recover a lost file credential; ask the sender for another copy or use your own backup.
